field_coordinates: +X audience-right, +Y away from audience, +Z above tile top; field center is (0,0,0)

above_floor_foot_bars.orientation: along field Y, on left and right sides of frame, not across center corridor

moving_hive.opposite_stable_pose: CAD blue hive rotated -60deg around field X; exact Y bounds mirror, Z minimum unchanged
moving_hive.bound_derivation: Split allowed 60deg sweep into two 30deg halves, each bounded from nearest exact endpoint AABB. At either endpoint, z>=43.9497-(43.9497-30.651541)*cos(30deg)-20.064099*sin(30deg). This is a guaranteed lower bound, not the actual underside minimum.

provenance.manual_relevance: Figure 9-10 labels 30deg tilt and nominal 30.6in underside. G409 example D explicitly describes driving under HIVE. Section9.1 specifies nominal field tolerance generally +/-1in.
provenance.method: OCCT8 read of STEP assembly transforms; exact BREP Boolean common of entire FRAME with above-tile Z[0,19] and left/right half spaces; BRepBndLib.AddOptimal(useTriangulation=False,useShapeTolerance=False). Supports rounded outward to0.1in.
provenance.limitation: Nominal CAD geometry, not measurement of the user's actual field; not valid for robot extensions above18in without recomputing collision slice. The overhead lower bound follows mechanically allowed nominal +/-30deg stops, not arbitrary360deg rotation.
